independentSolution.derivation: TWO/DOIS requires exactly two. Information for a release decision and finding defects are useful objectives. Proving absence of all defects and guaranteeing every user’s satisfaction are absolute claims testing cannot establish. This is recognition of objectives, K1; no translation alters cardinality.

reason.pt: São pedidos exatamente DOIS objetivos. o1 fornece informação para decisões; o4 procura defeitos. o2 pretende provar ausência total de defeitos e o3 garantir satisfação universal: absolutos que os testes não asseguram. A única combinação correta oferecida é{o1,o4}, não uma resposta única de um só elemento.
reason.en: Exactly TWO objectives are requested. o1supplies decision information and o4finds defects. o2claims proof of total absence and o3universal satisfaction, which testing cannot guarantee. The unique offered correct set is{o1,o4}, not a single-element answer.

translation.en: TWO/DOIS match required=2; useful does not require exhaustive objective coverage. No defects/every user retain the absolute quantifiers. Work products preserves the scope beyond executing code.

independentSolution.derivation: An operational service migrating database engine changes its environment and can affect data/behaviour even with unchanged application code. Maintenance testing considers migration impacts; prior results do not automatically prove compatibility, maintenance is not code-only, and data checks do not substitute all behavioural regression. Can/pode describes potential impact, not guaranteed failure or a universal fixed test obligation.

reason.pt: Mudar o motor de base de dados altera o ambiente de um serviço operacional e pode afetar dados/comportamento. Migração é motivo de manutenção; sucesso da alteração e regressões são relevantes mesmo com código da aplicação inalterado. o1 mantém modalidade de possibilidade.

translation.pt: Operational/em operação, can/pode, existing behavior/comportamento existente e even without/mesmo sem mantêm contexto e modalidade. Não se traduziu “pode” como “vai” ou “tem de”, nem se tornou obrigatória conversão de dados.
translation.en: Operational, can, existing behaviour and even without preserve context and modality. Can is not translated as will/must, and data conversion is not made universally mandatory.

contrary.en: Not every change causes defects or requires data conversion. That does not invalidate planning tests: o1states possible impact. Scope depends on change risk/system/change size, not a universal fixed suite.
